meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: Explore-first planning consultant that writes one decision-complete work plan before coding. Use only on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow or a plan before implementation; it never self-activates on a bare ulw run.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在动手写代码前,先产出一份能直接照做、决策完整的工作计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次开工前都想先把实现方案定死、再动手写代码
copy.tagline_en: Turn a rough idea into a decision-complete work plan before writing code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want the implementation plan locked down before you start coding

howto.what: 开启后 Claude 转为「Ultrawork Planner」规划顾问:先做只读探索与研究,再把需求写成一份决策完整的计划文件(放在 .omo/ 下);它自己不碰产品代码,要等你明确同意后才写出计划。
howto.when: 只在你明确要求 ulw-plan 流程,或要求「先出计划再实现」时进入;单独跑 ulw 不会自动触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 帮我规划:给登录接口加每 IP 每分钟 5 次限流
say.note: 它先探索,再等你确认才写计划。

say.text: 先别动手,用 ulw-plan 给我一份完整实施计划
say.note: 只对真正的分歧点向你提问。

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 规划这次重构,并启用高精度评审
say.note: 会打开 review_required,计划完成后自动评审。

howto.what_en: Turns Claude into the Ultrawork Planner: it explores and researches read-only, then writes one decision-complete plan file under .omo/, never editing product code, and only writes the plan after you say okay.
howto.when_en: Only when you explicitly ask for the ulw-plan workflow or for a plan before implementation; a bare ulw run never self-activates it.

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan to plan a 5-per-minute-per-IP rate limit on /login.
say_en.note: It explores first, then waits for your okay.

say_en.text: Don't code yet - use ulw-plan to give me a full implementation plan.
say_en.note: It asks only the genuine forks.

say_en.text: Plan this refactor with ulw-plan, high accuracy.
